# Sneh.K

> Sneh.K is the freelance digital advertising consultancy of Snehdeep Kaur, based in Canada. She plans, runs and audits Google Ads and paid media campaigns (Google, YouTube, Meta, LinkedIn) for lead generation and sales, with clean conversion tracking.

## Services

- Full-funnel campaign strategy: awareness, consideration and sales campaigns
- Ad spend management and audits: match types, negative keywords, exclusions, bid strategy
- B2B and D2C lead generation on Google, Meta and LinkedIn Ads
- Tracking setup and analytics: conversion tracking, attribution, Performance Max
